[[There Goes the Neighborhood]] | followed by = [[Ministry of Oppression (Hard mode)]] | map = [[File:There Goes The Neighborhood.jpg|250px]] | map1text = Route from [[Kaineng Center]]. }} Save the peasants from the revenge seeking mercenaries! ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== * Travel to [[Bukdek Byway]] to protect the citizens from the retreating gangs. * Defeat the mercenaries attacking civilians. * Do not allow more than three groups of [[Peasant]]s to die. * Listen to [[Eri, Heart of Fire]] and determine her fate. * See [[Guardsman Qao Lin]] for your reward. ===Reward=== *6,000 Experience *3,000 Gold *[[Imperial Guard Requisition Order]] *Imperial Guard Requisition Order *[[Imperial Commendation]] ==See also== * Quest walkthrough, NPCs, dialogue, and notes can be found on [[There Goes the Neighborhood]].
